metadata.name: LapicqueNeuron
metadata.author: Lapicque, L.
metadata.description: Leaky-capacitor polarization threshold; no source-defined post-event reset

dynamics.v: I * polarization_resistance / (series_resistance + polarization_resistance) + (v - I * polarization_resistance / (series_resistance + polarization_resistance)) * exp(-dt * (series_resistance + polarization_resistance) / (capacitance * series_resistance * polarization_resistance))

extensions.input_contract: I is Lapicque's source voltage V, not injected membrane current
extensions.event_contract: first threshold attainment is latched; no automatic source reset
extensions.default_scope: normalized maintained R/rho=10 and beta=1 ms reproducibility point
extensions.identity_note: sc_lapicque_lif preserves the historical SC hard-reset periodic LIF recurrence
